# Data for September 1975
receipts = 753   # millions
expenditures = 735  # millions (excluding investments)

# Surplus or deficit?
if receipts > expenditures:
    status = 'surplus'
    diff = receipts - expenditures
else:
    status = 'deficit'
    diff = expenditures - receipts

print(f'Total receipts: {receipts}')
print(f'Total expenditures (excl. investments): {expenditures}')
print(f'Receipts - Expenditures = {receipts} - {expenditures} = {receipts - expenditures}')
print(f'Status: {status}')

# Gini coefficient for two values
# Gini = |x1 - x2| / (n * mean) = |x1 - x2| / (2 * (x1+x2)/2) = |x1 - x2| / (x1 + x2)
x = [receipts, expenditures]
n = len(x)
mean_x = sum(x) / n
gini_numerator = sum(abs(a - b) for a in x for b in x)
gini = gini_numerator / (2 * n * sum(x))
print(f'Gini numerator (sum of |ai-aj|): {gini_numerator}')
print(f'n = {n}, sum(x) = {sum(x)}, mean = {mean_x}')
print(f'Gini = {gini_numerator} / ({2} * {n} * {sum(x)}) = {gini_numerator} / {2*n*sum(x)} = {gini}')
print(f'Gini rounded to 3 decimal places: {round(gini, 3)}')
print(f'Final answer: [{round(gini, 3)}, {status}]')
"

# Verify Gini for two values using multiple formulas

# Formula 2: Gini = (sum of |xi - xj|) / (2*n * sum of xi)
x = [r, e]
n = len(x)
s = sum(abs(a-b) for i, a in enumerate(x) for j, b in enumerate(x) if i < j)
gini2 = s / (2 * n * sum(x))
print(f'Formula 2: Gini = {s} / ({2*n}*{sum(x)}) = {gini2}')

# Both formulas agree
print(f'Both formulas give: {gini1:.10f}')
print(f'Rounded to 3 decimal places: {round(gini1, 3)}')

# Surplus check
diff = r - e
print(f'Receipts - Expenditures = {diff} > 0, so surplus')
"

arguments.command:
python3 -c "
# Standard Gini coefficient formulas verified
# For any distribution: Gini = Mean Absolute Difference / (2 * Mean)

r = 753  # total receipts (millions)
e = 735  # total expenditures excl. investments (millions)

x = [r, e]
n = len(x)
mean_x = sum(x) / n
print(f'Values: {x}')
print(f'n = {n}, Mean = {mean_x}')

# Mean Absolute Difference = sum of |xi - xj| over all pairs / n
# For all i,j pairs:
total_abs_diff = sum(abs(a-b) for a in x for b in x)
print(f'Sum of |xi - xj| over all ordered pairs: {total_abs_diff}')
mad = total_abs_diff / n  # mean absolute difference
print(f'Mean Absolute Difference (MAD): {mad}')

# Standard Gini: G = MAD / (2 * mean)
gini = mad / (2 * mean_x)
print(f'Standard Gini = MAD / (2 * mean) = {mad} / {2*mean_x} = {gini}')
print(f'Gini = {gini:.10f}')

# Verify equivalence with the compact formula
# G = |x1 - x2| / (x1 + x2) for two values
gini2 = abs(r - e) / (r + e)
print(f'Compact formula: |{r}-{e}| / ({r}+{e}) = {abs(r-e)} / {r+e} = {gini2}')
print(f'Both agree: {abs(gini - gini2) < 1e-10}')

# Round to 3 decimal places
print(f'Gini rounded to 3 decimal places: {round(gini, 3)}')

# Surplus/deficit
diff = r - e
print(f'Receipts - Expenditures = {r} - {e} = {diff}')
print(f'Status: surplus' if diff > 0 else 'deficit')
print(f'Final: [{round(gini, 3)}, surplus]')
"
